page.overview:
Who is Cody Rhodes?

Cody Rhodes is an American professional wrestler who will be portraying Guile in the upcoming movie Street Fighter. He is known for being a eight-time Tag Team Champion, two-time WWE Intercontinental Champion, 1 time ROH World Championship, 1 time ROH World Six-Man Tag Team Championship, 1 time Alpha-1 Tag Team Champion, 1 time IWGP United States Heavyweight Championship, 1 time NWA World's Heavyweight Champion, 3 time TNT Champion and 2 time WWE Champion and have appeared in Scooby-Doo! and WWE: Curse of the Speed Demon, The Jetsons & WWE: Robo-WrestleMania!, The Naked Gun and episodes of Warehouse 17 and Arrow.
